desc: The only document in the public record that enumerates the specific adverse actions taken against Grusch. Rep. Eli Crane wrote the Department of Defense on 24 July 2025 on behalf of Major David Charles Grusch, stating that because of his participation in UAP disclosure he suffered reprisal including removal of his security clearance, denial of promotion, and loss of medical retirement. Crane entered the letter into the record of the 9 September 2025 Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets hearing, noting on the record that he was still awaiting a reply; Chairwoman Luna committed to following up with DoD. Three specific, verifiable administrative actions - a clearance revocation, a promotion denial, and a retirement determination - each of which generates its own paper trail inside DoD, and none of which the Department has publicly explained.
